key_outcomes.summary: Single-episode run shows some positive reward but no measurable success, with heavy mentor reliance indicating gaps in autonomous execution.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Mentor dependency during decision points leading to stalled progress

skill_cards.if_condition: When an initial target scope is provided but success criteria are unclear
skill_cards.then_action: Clarify objective and define measurable success criteria before actioning

skill_cards.if_condition: When encountering a decision fork with multiple viable actions
skill_cards.then_action: Prioritize actions by impact-to-effort ratio and select highest value next step

skill_cards.if_condition: When mentor calls are increasing within a single episode
skill_cards.then_action: Pause and execute a brief self-checklist to reduce dependency

memory_ops.reason: Clarifying objectives early is critical to converting reward into measurable success.

next_experiments.title: Reduce mentor dependency
next_experiments.description: Run a single episode with a strict limit of 3 mentor calls and enforce the self-checklist before each action.

next_experiments.title: Objective-first planning
next_experiments.description: Begin the episode by explicitly defining success criteria and aligning the first three actions to those criteria.

next_experiments.title: Impact-to-effort triage
next_experiments.description: At each decision fork, rank actions by impact-to-effort and document the chosen next step with expected outcome.
